titulo.alumno: An imaginary situation · Possibility and condition

intro: Part 2: an imaginary situation. Notice which form expresses the relationship and go back to the sentence to check it.

frases.estudio: Hvis hun havde mere tid, ville hun læse rapporten.
frases.alumno: If she had more time, she would read the report.

frases.estudio: Hun ville også tale med naboerne.
frases.alumno: She would also talk to the neighbours.

texto: «Hvis» introduces a condition. In an open possibility the present is normally used; in an imagined situation the past can appear with «ville» in the main clause. Pay attention to the context, not only to the verb form.
Notice which form expresses the relationship and go back to the sentence to check it.
